You will deal with complex networking challenges, identity management, and high-availability systems where security and performance are equally paramount.

- Lead and Empower: Drive a high-performing team of developers, fostering a culture of technical ownership, security-first mindset, and continuous delivery.

- Architectural Leadership: Oversee the development of scalable, high-performance gateway and proxy architectures that support global enterprise scales.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management and Security Researchers to implement Zero Trust principles and advanced session monitoring capabilities.
- Mentor and Grow: Invest in your team’s professional growth, promoting best practices in code quality, security protocols, and system resilience.

Requirements

- Proven Leadership: 3+ years of experience leading R&D teams in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong Technical Foundation: 5+ years of experience in backend development, with a strong track record of building complex systems in Python.
- AI & LLM Architecture: experience building and deploying production-grade LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and natural language interfaces.
- System Architecture: Experience building distributed, high-availability systems that handle real-time traffic and data.
- AI-Assisted Development: Proficiency in utilizing AI development tools (specifically Cursor and Claude) to accelerate development workflows, code generation, and problem-solving.
